note: Attacker-controlled projection string "+proj=geos +R=6400000" (deliberately without +h) is converted into the parameter list that drives projection setup.
The geos projection-specific setup (pj_projection_specific_setup_geos) is invoked with the user-controlled parameter list.
Because +h is absent from the parameters, Q->h evaluates to 0.0 and the guard is true, routing into the error destructor.

The generic destructor frees P->params, the opaque object Q (which holds the unneeded sweep_axis member), and P itself, but the call is not returned from: setup continues executing on the freed objects. sweep_axis is unneeded (only used locally) and its free, via the freed opaque object, is incorrect.
First dereference of the already-freed PJ object: reading P->phi0 is a heap-use-after-free, the fault the sanitizer reports when the PoC is executed.
